argument.one_loop_extra_dimensional_decomposition: write l_D=l_4+l_perp and mu2=-l_perp^2; powers mu2^r map to dimension-shifted scalar/tensor integrals multiplied by a product containing D-4=-2 epsilon

argument.one_loop_pole_order: with no IR pole in the scoped off-shell masters, the relevant evanescent dimension-shifted integrals can contribute at epsilon^0 only through at most a simple UV 1/epsilon pole
argument.uv_locality: the residue of the one-loop UV pole is local in external momenta; multiplying it by the explicit O(epsilon) evanescent factor yields a finite rational/local R2-type term
argument.branch_cut_consequence: local/rational R2-type completion has no hard logarithmic/polylogarithmic branch cut at q2=-1,-0.34,-0.14; therefore its D_s in those frozen hard channels is zero
argument.nonlocal_terms: any finite nonlocal/logarithmic part of the dimension-shifted integral is multiplied by O(epsilon) and vanishes as epsilon->0 in the missing evanescent contribution
